repo_notes.content: SCOPE — what this repository is and is not. The product is Salon1cAPI, an unofficial Swift client for the 1С:SPA-Салон API (редакция 3.0) hosted at cloud.salon1c.ru, generated with Apple's swift-openapi-generator and exposed as-is so that every request the API accepts remains expressible. It is not a 1С product and is not affiliated with 1С. Sources/Salon1cAPI/openapi.yaml is generated output: the vendor's own OpenAPI 3.1 document vendored verbatim at Upstream/salon1c-openapi/api_salon1c.yaml plus a declared patch layer (apply-patches.sh, patches/). Every correction — operationId curation, typed JSON-in-query parameters, the vendor's own spec defects — is a commented patch entry; upstream files are never edited and the output file is never hand-edited. The older Apiary Blueprint lives at Upstream/salon1c/salon1c.apib as a secondary source (the Apiary mock replays it; a few wire dialects it documents are preserved through patches). Several root-level Markdown files are process artefacts, not product documentation: CLAUDE.md is agent instructions and REVIEW.md steers automated PR review.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCES, in precedence order. The DocC catalogue at Sources/Salon1cAPI/Salon1cAPI.docc/ is authoritative for architecture and direction; where it and README.md disagree the catalogue wins. Design.md holds every load-bearing decision with the alternative that was rejected. SpecOwnership.md describes the vendored-upstream + declared-patch model and summarizes the patch register (P1–P27) — the article a reader should reach first. WorkingWithSalon1c.md records documented quirks of the API — including the six response-envelope dialects (from {parameters, errors} through PascalCase to errors nested inside parameters on price_list; map in SpecOwnership.md) and the in-body domain error catalogue 1000–1114 — plus dated wire observations as they arrive. TechDebt.md lists every compromise carried (TD-9 is the vendor-defect register mirrored by the patch script), what it costs and what would retire it. Roadmap.md is the planned work in priority order. Upstream/salon1c-openapi/ holds the vendor OpenAPI + PDF verbatim with the pipeline README.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: CONSUMER CONSTRAINTS that any useful page set must convey. The package requires Swift 6.2 or newer and iOS 17 / macOS 14 / tvOS 17 / watchOS 10 / visionOS 1. Requests go over URLSession through Apple's Swift OpenAPI URLSession transport, and generated code is produced by the build plugin and never committed. Authentication is two header credentials — apikey on every request, usertoken on client-scoped operations — carried by Credentials/AuthMiddleware, not by generated code; the vendor document also declares a basicAuth scheme for direct-to-base deployments which this client does not implement. The default server is the documented http://cloud.salon1c.ru/api/, but per-salon on-premises deployments exist, so Client.init(serverURL:) is a first-class escape hatch rather than a test hook. The spine of the package is the pipeline: vendor yaml → apply-patches.sh → openapi.yaml → build plugin → generated surface; every divergence is auditable at the patch level. An opt-in, generated facade — Sources/Salon1cAPI/Operations+Payload.generated.swift, regenerated deterministically by Scripts/generate-facade.sh — adds payload() to each envelope operation's Output, folding the error channels into Salon1cError (refused / status / undocumentedStatus / missingPayload) without merging them.
